name: BioResearcher 生物医学研究
description: Biomedical research plugin for OpenCode v2: delivers the bioresearcher skills and the deep-research subagent via the v2 plugin API; the biomcp MCP server (literature, trials, genes, variants, drugs, diseases, patents) is wired through mcp.servers config.
description_zh: OpenCode v2 生物医学研究插件：通过 v2 插件 API 提供生物医学技能与深度调研子代理；biomcp MCP 服务（文献、临床试验、基因、变异、药物、疾病与专利）经 mcp.servers 配置接入。
description_en: Biomedical research plugin for OpenCode v2: delivers the bioresearcher skills and the deep-research subagent via the v2 plugin API; the biomcp MCP server (literature, clinical trials, genes, variants, drugs, diseases, patents) is wired through mcp.servers config.
examples_zh: 帮我做一个关于肿瘤免疫治疗的多方面文献综述并附引用
总结上周 PubMed 更新中与 CRISPR 相关的文献
查找 BRAF V600E 变异的相关药物与临床试验
examples_en: Run a multi-aspect literature review on tumor immunotherapy with citations
Summarize last week's PubMed updates about CRISPR
Find drugs and clinical trials related to the BRAF V600E variant
